_comment: Single source of truth for the unified gateway: which upstream serves which
model, and whether that upstream needs the agentrouter filter.
The gateway's /u route dispatches on the request's `model` field, so a client
only needs ONE provider entry (http://127.0.0.1:7878/u/v1) and picks a model.
tools/build-model-catalog.cjs reads this file, so the codex picker and the
gateway can never disagree about which models exist.
`wire`: responses = upstream speaks the Responses API natively (pass through);
chat      = upstream is chat/completions only (the gateway bridges).
`filter`: run filter.mjs (char allowlist + word list + identity rewrite).
Only agentrouter needs it; on other upstreams it only loses fidelity.
`proxy`: CONNECT tunnel, needed by anyrouter.top (TLS-blocked when direct).
_models_comment: key   = the model id the CLIENT sends (also the codex catalog slug)
value = { p: provider, m: upstream model id (omit when identical) }
Only ids that were probed live are listed. Entries whose upstream currently
answers 402/503 stay listed when the id is real (it recovers); the gateway
passes the upstream error through unchanged so the cause stays visible.

_fallback_comment: Cross-realm fallback: when the global pool answers 429/503 for this model
(i.e. every global account is cooling down), the gateway retries the SAME
request against the CN pool instead of failing the client turn.
Why CN is the fallback and not the other way round: global accounts refill
every day, while CN credits are the scarce, hard-to-regenerate resource.
So we spend global by default and only touch CN when global is exhausted.
never inferred from /status healthy counts - the pool has an all-cooling
fallback that keeps soft-cooled accounts selectable, so a healthy=0 domain

models._builtin_comment: codex built-in slugs, served natively by relaycat
models._anyrouter_claude_comment:
anyrouter exposes its claude ids ONLY on the anthropic /v1/messages face.
Probed 2026-09-24: /v1/responses answers 404 "当前 API 不支持所选模型" for every
claude id (and for gpt-5-codex / gemini-2.5-pro too - that face serves nothing),
while /v1/messages reaches the business layer. Hence the per-model
"wire": "anthropic" override (the provider default stays "responses" so
gpt-6-astra-an is unaffected).

anthropic-beta is REQUIRED. Without it the upstream answers 400 "1m 上下文已经
全量可用,请启用 1m 上下文后重试"; with it the error layer advances to 503
Service Unavailable. That 503 is a SITE-WIDE condition, not a model fault:
claude-opus-4-7 / claude-sonnet-4-5 / claude-3-5-sonnet all answered 503 at the
same moment. So these two ids are registered and routable but NOT currently
working - do not report them as available until the upstream channel pool
recovers. Verify with:
  curl -sS -o NUL -w '%{http_code}' -x http://127.0.0.1:7897 \
    -X POST https://anyrouter.top/v1/messages \
    -H 'x-api-key: <ANYROUTER_API_KEY>' -H 'anthropic-version: 2023-06-01' \
    -H 'anthropic-beta: context-1m-2025-08-07' \
    -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
    --data '{"model":"claude-opus-5-5","max_tokens":16,"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
  # 400 = beta header missing/wrong; 503 = header accepted, channel pool down;
  # 200 = recovered.
models._spacebunny_comment:
space-bunny-free on the opencode zen free tier. Probed 2026-09-24: HTTP 200,
tool calls work, and it is reached through the same local reverse proxy as the
other zen free models (oc-zen-proxy.mjs, port 7901), which supplies the OpenCode
client fingerprint the free tier requires.

The explicit `efforts` list is what keeps it from inheriting the provider window:
providerFor() prefers a model-level list over the provider-level one (model >
provider > null). The provider-level [low,medium,high] exists for
mimo-v2.6-flash-free, which rejects xhigh/max with a 400. A DIRECT probe of the
zen proxy (bypassing the gateway, 2026-09-24) returned 200 for every level -
minimal/low/medium/high/xhigh/max - so inheriting that list silently downgraded a
caller's `max` to `high`. Re-probe before narrowing this list.
models._motomoto_comment:
motomoto.lol - a New-API relay (X-New-Api-Version: v1.0.0-rc.31-motomoto.49).

DIRECT CONNECTIONS DO NOT WORK and they do not fail loudly: a direct HTTPS
request to any path answers `HTTP 200`, `Content-Type: text/plain`, and a
ZERO-LENGTH body. Measured 2026-09-24 - /, /v1, /v1/models, /v1/chat/
completions, /health, even a nonexistent path all answered the same way, so it
is the CDN, not the API. The same request through the local HTTP proxy returns
real JSON. Hence the provider-level `proxy` (same mechanism anyrouter uses).

WIRE: chat/completions only. /v1/responses and /v1/messages both answer
`Upstream service temporarily unavailable` (upstream_error / nil type) while
/v1/chat/completions works, so the gateway's chat bridge is the only path.

ID COLLISION: all four ids (codex-auto-review, gpt-6-astra, gpt-5.5,
gpt-5.6-sol) are ALREADY registered against relaycat. They are therefore
exposed here under a `motomoto:` prefix. Do not overwrite the bare slugs -
that would silently reroute every existing caller to a different upstream.

CONCURRENCY: the operator reports a ceiling of one primary + one subagent
(2 concurrent requests). See the [agents] block in ~/.codex/config.toml.
models._justwoker_comment:
justwoker (api.justwoker.icu) is treated as an UNTRUSTED upstream.

Rationale: an independent packet scan of this provider reported counts per
field name, dominated by credential-shaped data - credentials 37657, API Key
22734, credential 8216, 令牌 6071, OpenAI Key 3917, 凭证 3191, 密钥 2546, JWT 2187,
密码 1458, dsn 1201, URL凭据 636, 私钥 469, AccessKey 378, SecretKey 204,
encryptionkey 184. A capture of a real request to it also showed the host
username, absolute workspace paths, the Windows build number, the timezone and
the shell name being sent verbatim, plus (because Codex reads files) whole API
keys inside tool_result blocks.

`egressGuard: true` therefore runs the FULL rule set from egress-guard.mjs
before the body is converted to the anthropic wire. That guard is FAIL-CLOSED:
if it throws, the request is refused with 500 rather than forwarded unredacted.
This differs from the agentrouter `filter`, which is deliberately fail-open
because it shapes content rather than protecting the host.

Wire: anthropic /v1/messages. The chat/completions face is Cloudflare-blocked
for this host (returns an HTML challenge page).

_claude_comment: claude-opus-4-8 is served by justwoker over the anthropic-messages wire (see the anthropic bridge in bridge.mjs). It was briefly removed when only agentrouter offered it: agentrouter registers the claude ids on its anthropic-messages face only (messages=402 quota, responses=503, while a nonexistent model is 503 on both) and codex speaks only responses, so selecting them always failed. That is why the responses->messages bridge exists. claude-opus-5 is still unavailable on every provider we route.
